subject.title: feat(google): enable raw-transcript reseed for antigravity-cli (multi-turn context fix)

question: Should this raw-transcript reseed follow-up land as `google-antigravity-cli`, fold into #90975, or be ported to the current `google-antigravity` provider direction?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but the runtime id, doctor ownership, docs, and stacked PR relationship define the support contract for Antigravity users and cannot be chosen safely from automation alone.

options.title: Fold into the accepted Antigravity CLI backend
options.body: Keep the reseed behavior on the backend that maintainers choose for #90975, then require the stale Gemini test, doctor ownership, and docs gaps to be fixed before merge.

options.title: Port to the `google-antigravity` provider direction
options.body: Move the useful reseed behavior into the newer first-class Antigravity provider path and close or rebase this stacked PR once that path owns the feature.

options.title: Pause until Antigravity support settles
options.body: Leave this PR open but blocked until the broader Antigravity runtime/auth decision resolves the supported provider id and migration shape.

recommendation.title: Fold into the accepted Antigravity CLI backend
recommendation.body: Keep the reseed behavior on the backend that maintainers choose for #90975, then require the stale Gemini test, doctor ownership, and docs gaps to be fixed before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the clearest recent history on the Google CLI runtime/auth and manifest surfaces that determine the support contract here.
